description: Repositories, pull requests and signed repository events.
label: GitHub

vars.name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
vars.what: Shared secret for GitHub webhook signatures

tools.name: recent_events
tools.description: List recent GitHub webhook event types, timestamps (Unix milliseconds) and subscriber counts received by LifeOS, newest first.

agents.name: GitHub Activity Reviewer
agents.description: Summarizes GitHub events received by LifeOS.
agents.instructions: Use recent_events to summarize received GitHub activity. Group by event type and give the latest reception time. Say when there are no events. Never infer repository names or pull request details from event counts.

automations.title: GitHub activity digest
automations.instructions: Summarize the most recent 20 received GitHub events. Report counts by type and when the latest event arrived.
